name: logic_bench_yn
description: A small benchmark of binary (yes/no) natural language logic problems intended to evaluate a model's ability to perform binary logical reasoning and consistency checks. Items present short prompts or scenarios with a required yes/no answer that exercises deduction, implication, and simple reasoning chains. Useful for quick checks of reasoning capabilities in language models.
reputation: Low-profile community dataset hosted on Hugging Face, used mainly for small-scale logic-reasoning probes rather than widely adopted benchmark suites.
